lines: This is Mayor Raven. Your invoice is still due. Patrol the alley and pretend that's civic duty.
The Basement Clinic billed you for growth you skipped. I hold the eviction and the punchline.
Quick Patrol is not community service. It is a receipt with sneakers.
If the Son vaults a rail, bill the coach. If the Father webs a cop, bill the city.
Processing Floor still has a Director. He has a Family Plan. You have a fridge.
Copay Orchard is a wellness weekend you never booked. The lake still wants a copay.
Sleet Hour is the retreat after it froze. Don't sit. Sitting is how they win.
Raven Grid is not Dock Street with extra pink. Steal the lemon. Do not brake on the ramp.
Ledger Dive is a spa they billed as therapy. The ads are drowning. That's the surprise.
